name: Exp_TimeZonePivotsOpenSystem
summary: This EA calculates pivot points based on a configurable time zone session and trades the open of a new session relative to the pivot levels. It enters long when the session opens above the pivot and short when it opens below, targeting S1/R1 levels with stop losses placed beyond S2/R2, implementing a classic time-zone pivot open system.
summary_zh: 该EA基于可配置时区时段计算支点(Pivot)价位，并在新时段开盘时根据价格与支点的关系进行交易。时段开盘价高于支点则做多，低于支点则做空，目标为S1/R1，止损设于S2/R2之外，实现了经典的时区支点开盘系统。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于时段支点理论，利用特定时区的开盘价与当日支点的关系判断方向偏好。入场条件为：新时段开盘时，若开盘价高于中央支点(Pivot)则做多，若低于支点则做空，这是一种趋势确认型的开盘突破策略。出场条件包括：盈利目标设于第一支撑/阻力位(S1/R1)，止损设于第二支撑/阻力位(S2/R2)之外，风险回报比合理。仓位管理方面，EA提供了手数参数供用户配置，但未见到基于账户余额或波动率的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理依赖于固定止损和止盈目标，风险可控但缺乏头寸规模化的自适应能力。整体策略逻辑清晰，结合了时段特性和支点理论，适合流动性较好的时段开盘交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on time-zone pivot theory, using the relationship between the session open price and the daily pivot to determine directional bias. Entry conditions: at the open of a new configured time zone session, if the open price is above the central pivot, a long position is initiated; if below the pivot, a short is taken, making this a trend-confirmation open breakout approach. Exit conditions: take-profit targets are set at the first support/resistance levels (S1/R1), while stop losses are placed beyond the second support/resistance levels (S2/R2), providing a reasonable risk-reward ratio. Position sizing relies on a user-configured lot size parameter without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or volatility. Money management depends on fixed stop-loss and take-profit targets, which keeps risk defined but lacks adaptive position scaling. Overall, the strategy logic is clear and combines session characteristics with pivot point theory, making it suitable for trading session opens in liquid markets.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于经典支点理论，有明确的方向判断标准
使用时段开盘价作为信号，避免了盘中噪音干扰，信号质量较高
止损和止盈基于支点层级设置，风险回报比合理且与市场结构一致
时区可配置，适应不同交易者的时段偏好和不同市场的开盘时间
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on classic pivot point theory with well-defined directional criteria
Session open price as signal avoids intraday noise, resulting in higher quality signals
Stop-loss and take-profit based on pivot levels provide reasonable risk-reward ratios aligned with market structure
Configurable time zone adapts to different trader preferences and market session opens
cons: 依赖单一支点信号，缺少多维度确认，可能在震荡行情中频繁止损
仓位管理为固定手数，未根据账户风险或波动率动态调整
未包含 spread 过滤机制，在高点差时段开盘可能遭遇不利成交
缺乏趋势过滤器，在无明显趋势的横盘市场中支点突破信号可靠性下降
cons_en: Relies on a single pivot signal without multi-dimensional confirmation, prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets
Fixed lot position sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account risk or volatility
No spread filter included, potentially suffering from unfavorable fills during high-spread session opens
Lacks a trend filter, reducing signal reliability in sideways markets without clear directional bias
improvements: 增加多时间框架趋势过滤（如日线均线方向），仅在趋势方向一致时入场
引入基于ATR的动态仓位管理，根据波动率调整手数和止损距离
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filter (e.g., daily MA direction) to only enter trades aligned with the higher timeframe trend
Introduce ATR-based dynamic position sizing to adjust lot size and stop-loss distance according to current volatility

risk_points: 固定手数仓位管理在大波动时段可能导致单笔风险过高
无点差过滤，时段开盘时点差扩大可能造成不利入场
risk_points_en: Fixed lot sizing may result in excessive per-trade risk during high-volatility session opens
No spread filter may cause unfavorable entries when spreads widen at session open
